points.K14: 分流用于并联，分压用于串联
points.K15: 电压表并联，电流表串联

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在考官桌后，桌上放着空白题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits behind an examiner's desk with a stack of blank question cards, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 实验口试来了，一起来练一练！

shots.scene: 阿杰在走廊里紧张地翻实验报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nervously flips through a blank lab report in a corridor outside a lab.
shots.narration: 阿杰明天口试，心里直打鼓。

shots.scene: 小研拍拍他的肩，递上一张空白问题清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pats his shoulder and hands him a blank list of questions.
shots.narration: 小研说：常考的题，其实就这些。

shots.scene: 阿杰闭眼回想实验台和电路
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes his eyes; a thought bubble shows a lab bench with a power supply, lamps and meters.
shots.narration: 进考场前，先回想实验做了什么。

shots.scene: 实验台上的稳压电源、灯和电表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a regulated power supply, three small lamps and DC meters. No people.
shots.narration: 用了哪些器材，电路怎么接。

shots.scene: 导线里一串小圆点向前移动
shots.prompt_en: Inside a wire, a row of small dots moves forward in one direction. No people.
shots.narration: 什么是电？电子的运动。

shots.scene: 梳子吸纸屑和灯泡通电两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a comb attracting bits of paper, and a lit bulb connected to a battery. No people.
shots.narration: 电分两类：静电和电流。

shots.scene: 直线箭头和波浪箭头两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a straight arrow and a wavy arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电流又分直流和交流。

shots.scene: 坐标图上一条水平直线
shots.prompt_en: A simple graph with a flat horizontal line over time. No people.
shots.narration: 直流的大小方向不随时间变。

shots.scene: 坐标图上一条正弦波
shots.prompt_en: A simple graph with a sine wave over time. No people.
shots.narration: 交流随时间来回变化。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白纸上画两条曲线给考官看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sketches a flat line and a wave on a blank sheet and shows the older man.
shots.narration: 口试带上纸笔，画个图更清楚。

shots.scene: 电池、电子管、直流电动机、放映机四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a battery, a vacuum tube, a small DC motor and an old film projector. No people.
shots.narration: 电池、电子管、直流电机、放映机用直流。

shots.scene: 输电塔和墙上插座图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a power transmission tower and a wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 电力系统和日常供电用交流。

shots.scene: 一长一短两根导线，长的电阻符号更大
shots.prompt_en: Two wires of different lengths; the longer one has a larger resistor symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 导线越长，电阻越大。

shots.scene: 一粗一细两根导线，细的电阻符号更大
shots.prompt_en: A thick wire and a thin wire; the thin one has a larger resistor symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 截面越大，电阻越小。

shots.scene: 白板上的公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard showing a simple resistance formula with letter symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻等于电阻率乘长度除以截面积。

shots.scene: 电阻率符号旁边标着单位
shots.prompt_en: A rho symbol next to a unit label. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻率的单位是欧姆米。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 口试别轻视，这些要点要记牢。

shots.scene: 电压和电流两条柱同步变高
shots.prompt_en: Two bars, voltage and current, rise together in proportion, with a thermometer and a pressure gauge both showing steady levels. No people.
shots.narration: 温度压力不变，电压电流成正比。

shots.scene: 绝缘体和半导体芯片图标旁打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an insulator and a semiconductor chip, each with a small red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘体、半导体不遵守欧姆定律。

shots.scene: 节点处三个箭头：两进一出
shots.prompt_en: A junction with two arrows flowing in and one arrow flowing out. No people.
shots.narration: 节点上，流进的电流等于流出的。

shots.scene: 闭合回路上电源和电阻的电压箭头
shots.prompt_en: A closed loop with a source and resistors, voltage arrows going around the loop. No people.
shots.narration: 闭合回路里，电压代数和为零。

shots.section_title: 分流用于并联，分压用于串联
shots.scene: 两个并联电阻，电流分成两路
shots.prompt_en: Two resistors in parallel with current splitting into two arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 分流公式，用在并联电路。
overlay: 分流用于并联，分压用于串联

shots.section_title: 分流用于并联，分压用于串联
shots.scene: 两个串联电阻，电压分成两段
shots.prompt_en: Two resistors in series with the voltage divided into two segments. No people.
shots.narration: 分压公式，用在串联电路。

shots.section_title: 电压表并联，电流表串联
shots.scene: 电压表跨在灯两端，电流表串在线路里
shots.prompt_en: Circuit icon: a voltmeter connected across a lamp and an ammeter connected in line. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表并联，电流表串联。
overlay: 电压表并联，电流表串联

shots.scene: 稳压直流电源图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a regulated DC power supply with blank display. No people.
shots.narration: RPS就是稳压直流电源。

shots.scene: 两只电表，一只表盘画波浪号，一只画直线
shots.prompt_en: Two meters, one with a wave symbol on its dial, one with a straight-line symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 动铁式仪表用于交流测量。

shots.scene: 磁电式电表连在电池上
shots.prompt_en: The meter with the straight-line symbol is connected to a battery. No people.
shots.narration: 磁电式，也叫动圈式，用于直流。

shots.scene: 做功图标除以时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A work icon divided by a clock icon equals a power icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电功率，就是单位时间做的功。

shots.scene: 阿杰站直，简短回答，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands straight and answers briefly; the older man nods.
shots.narration: 回答要简短清楚，大方自信。

shots.scene: 阿杰想起自己接线的情景
shots.prompt_en: A thought bubble above the young male student shows him wiring a circuit in the lab.
shots.narration: 联系自己做过的实验来答。

shots.scene: 直流电路图上电源和电表都标正负号
shots.prompt_en: A DC circuit diagram with plus and minus signs at the source and the meters. No people.
shots.narration: 画直流电路，记得标正负极。

shots.scene: 交流电路图上没有正负号
shots.prompt_en: An AC circuit diagram with a sine wave source symbol and no polarity marks. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电路不用标极性。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，老周微笑回答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the older man smiles and answers.
shots.narration: 好好准备，有疑问就问。

shots.scene: 一叠空白题卡，最上面一张打勾
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank question cards with a green check on the top card. No people.
shots.narration: 概念、定律、仪表，答题要点记牢。

shots.scene: 直流交流、串联并联、电压表电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: DC and AC graphs, series and parallel resistors, a voltmeter and an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 分清直交流、串并联、表的接法。

shots.scene: 阿杰走出考场，和欣欣击掌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks out of the exam room smiling and gives the panda mascot a high five.
shots.narration: 口试顺利通过，下次见！
